title: Etaleness of the morphism induced by an infinitesimal pushout triple
statement: Let $B$ be a scheme and work with algebraic spaces over $B$ [def-trf-algebraic-space] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], with sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. A thickening is a representable closed immersion inducing a homeomorphism on underlying spaces, whose topology is the quotient topology from a surjective etale scheme atlas; closed immersions are tested on scheme base changes [def-weil-closed-immersion]. An affine map is representable and every scheme base change is an affine scheme morphism. Let $A\hookrightarrow A^+$ be a thickening, let $A\to C$ be affine, and let $Q=C\amalg_A A^+$ be their pushout in algebraic spaces [lem-sfb-space-affine-thickening-pushout]. Let $X\to C$ and $Y\to A^+$ be chartwise etale morphisms [def-sfb-space-chartwise-etale-morphism], and let $\phi:X\times_C A\xrightarrow{\sim}Y\times_{A^+}A$ be an isomorphism over $A$. Put $U=X\times_C A$ and use $\phi$ to define $U\to Y$. Form the pushout $Z=X\amalg_U Y$, which exists by [lem-sfb-space-affine-thickening-pushout]. Then the unique morphism $Z\to Q$ whose restrictions are $X\to C\to Q$ and $Y\to A^+\to Q$ is chartwise etale. Here chartwise etale means that its composite with every representable etale map from a scheme to its source is representable etale. No separation, quasi-compactness, finite-order, or Noetherian hypothesis is imposed, and no algebraic space over $Q$ restricting to the given triple is assumed to exist.

proof.text: Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas $C_0\to C$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Put $A_0=C_0\times_C A$, a scheme affine over $C_0$ by the definition of the affine map $A\to C$. Its projection to $A$ is representable surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests]. Lift it across $A\hookrightarrow A^+$ using [lem-sfb-space-thickening-etale-scheme-equivalence], obtaining a scheme $A_0^+$ etale over $A^+$ and an identification $A_0^+\times_{A^+}A=A_0$. Both this closed restriction and $A\hookrightarrow A^+$ are thickenings by [lem-sfb-space-thickening-base-change]. Their homeomorphisms on point sets show that $A_0^+\to A^+$ is surjective, since $A_0\to A$ is. Apply [lem-sfb-space-pushout-lifted-atlas] to this compatible pair. It gives a scheme $Q_0=C_0\amalg_{A_0}A_0^+$ and a representable surjective etale map $Q_0\to Q$.

source.place: Tags 07VX and 07W1: choice of the base atlas cube

proof.text:
Choose a representable surjective etale scheme atlas $X_0\to X\times_C C_0$. The fibre product is an algebraic space by [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. The composite $X_0\to X$ is representable surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests]. Put $U_0=X_0\times_C A$. The affine map $A\to C$ makes it a scheme. Write $H=Y\times_{A^+}A_0^+$. Its closed restriction along $A_0\hookrightarrow A_0^+$ is
$$H_0=Y\times_{A^+}A_0\simeq U\times_A A_0\simeq (X\times_C C_0)\times_C A.$$
These are canonical fibre-product identifications using $\phi$. Thus $U_0\to H_0$ is the base change of the chosen atlas of $X\times_C C_0$, so is representable surjective etale. The map $H_0\hookrightarrow H$ is a thickening by [lem-sfb-space-thickening-base-change]. Lift $U_0\to H_0$ using [lem-sfb-space-thickening-etale-scheme-equivalence], obtaining a scheme $Y_0$ etale over $H$ and $Y_0\times_H H_0=U_0$. It is surjective by the same homeomorphism argument as in step 1. Hence $Y_0\to Y$ is representable surjective etale by [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests].

The lift gives $Y_0\times_{A_0^+}A_0=U_0=X_0\times_{C_0}A_0$. It also gives $Y_0\times_Y U=U_0$, since $H_0=H\times_Y U$. Thus $(X_0,Y_0)$ is a compatible pair of scheme atlases for the span $U\to X$, $U\hookrightarrow Y$. Here $U\to X$ is affine by testing the base change of $A\to C$ on schemes, and $U\hookrightarrow Y$ is a thickening by [lem-sfb-space-thickening-base-change]. Apply [lem-sfb-space-pushout-lifted-atlas] to that span. The scheme pushout $Z_0=X_0\amalg_{U_0}Y_0$ has a representable surjective etale map $z:Z_0\to Z$. The compatible maps $X_0\to C_0$ and $Y_0\to A_0^+$ induce $g_0:Z_0\to Q_0$. Its composite to $Q$ equals $Z_0\xrightarrow{z}Z\to Q$: the restrictions to $X_0$ and $Y_0$ agree, so equality follows from the pushout universal property against algebraic-space targets in [lem-sfb-space-affine-thickening-pushout].

source.place: Tag 07W2, compatible map of scheme pushouts and source atlas

proof.text: The maps $X_0\to C_0$ and $Y_0\to A_0^+$ are etale scheme morphisms. For the first, compose the chosen atlas with the base change of the chartwise etale map $X\to C$; for the second, compose the lifted atlas with the base change of $Y\to A^+$. Base change and composition preserve chartwise etaleness by [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence], and for scheme sources it is representable etaleness, hence ordinary scheme etaleness. Apply [lem-sfb-scheme-infinitesimal-etale-patching] to the scheme thickening $A_0\hookrightarrow A_0^+$, affine map $A_0\to C_0$ and compatible triple $(X_0,Y_0)$. It says precisely that the induced $g_0:Z_0\to Q_0$ is etale. By [lem-trf-space-representable-etale-scheme-tests], its composite with $Q_0\to Q$ is representable etale. This composite is $(Z\to Q)\circ z$ by step 3. Source-atlas detection [lem-trf-space-etale-source-atlas-detection], clause (3), now makes $Z\to Q$ chartwise etale. All auxiliary lifts used only arbitrary thickenings; no object over $Q$ realizing the triple was assumed.

lean.statement: theorem existsUnique_chartwiseEtale_affineThickeningPushout {B : Scheme.{u}} (A A' C Q : AlgebraicSpace B) (i : A ⟶ A') (a : A ⟶ C) (j : C ⟶ Q) (b : A' ⟶ Q) (hi : IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsClosedImmersion p.left) i.hom.hom) (hiTop : IsHomeomorph (mapPoint i.hom.hom)) (ha : IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsAffineHom p.left) a.hom.hom) (hQ : IsPushout a i j b) (X Y : AlgebraicSpace B) (x : X ⟶ C) (y : Y ⟶ A') (hx : IsChartwiseEtale x) (hy : IsChartwiseEtale y) (φ : enlargedFibreProduct x a ≅ enlargedFibreProduct y i) (hφ : φ.hom.hom ≫ Limits.pullback.snd y.hom i.hom = Limits.pullback.snd x.hom a.hom) (Z : AlgebraicSpace B) (u : X ⟶ Z) (v : Y ⟶ Z) (hZ : IsPushout (enlargedFibreProductFst x a) (φ.hom ≫ enlargedFibreProductFst y i) u v) : ∃! p : Z ⟶ Q, u ≫ p = x ≫ j ∧ v ≫ p = y ≫ b ∧ IsChartwiseEtale p
